en: I put his spirit to good use.\nLike I plan to do with your little friend.
old: 我让他的灵发挥了用处。
new: 我让他的灵体发挥了用处。
reason: b 类：『his spirit』指乌尔里克的灵被放逐之刃摄取、用于驱动实体盔甲（seq 551 齿轮转动、seq 556-557 空甲拼合成军队），属寄居于容器/盔甲中以实体形态存在的灵；且同场景 seq 558『using their spirits to power that armor』与 seq 560『an army of spirits』均已译「灵体」，按场景一致性规则同步为「灵体」。

en: He's almost cryptically telling me what I already know.{w}\nI know that the blade deals with the spirits of its victims.{w}\nThe Triumvirate used it to create their own massive army.
old: 我知道那把剑会摆布受害者的灵。
new: 我知道那把剑会摆布受害者的灵体。
reason: b 类：『the spirits of its victims』指被剑摄取、用于制造实体军队的受害者之灵，与 0002:seq 555-560 同一机制（灵寄居于剑/盔甲容器），该场景已定译「灵体」，跨场景同机制统一为「灵体」；下行 seq 898 的 soul→「灵魂」不受影响。

en: Underneath those cloaks, however, is anyone's guess.\nSome people even theorize that there's nothing underneath.\nThat's pretty scary, if you ask me. They'd be like living spirits.
